comments.text: The sheer contrast between those jagged limestone ridges in the north and the crystal-clear turquoise waters down south is unbelievable. You rarely see this level of raw, unpaved coastline left anywhere along the Mediterranean today. It feels completely untouched by mass commercial tourism.
